description: Get money home to family safely, cheaply, and on time.

steps.detail: Decide the exact amount in the currency you hold. Bigger amounts usually mean a lower percentage cost — but check the reporting threshold first.
steps.title: Decide how much to send

steps.detail: Use the assistant's transfer comparison: it ranks licensed methods by total cost (fees + FX margin) and speed for your corridor.
steps.title: Compare licensed methods

steps.detail: Name, account number, and bank code must match the recipient's bank records exactly. One wrong digit can freeze the money for weeks.
steps.title: Double-check recipient details

steps.detail: Start with a small test transfer if this is your first time using a new method or recipient account.
steps.title: Send a small test amount first

steps.detail: Keep the receipt and transaction ID until the recipient confirms the money arrived in full.
steps.title: Keep your receipt

steps.detail: Ask the recipient to confirm the received amount and the exchange rate applied — it should match the quote you accepted.
steps.title: Confirm receipt with your family

tips: Never split one transfer into many small ones to dodge reporting limits ('ants moving') — structuring is illegal.
Ignore strangers offering 'better rates' over chat apps.
title: How to send money home safely
